headline: Max Stock Reports 18% Q3 Revenue Growth to ILS 470.4 Million
summary: Israeli discount chain Max Stock posted a 17.9% rise in third-quarter revenue to ILS 470.4 million, with same-store sales up 11.2% and GAAP net income advancing 77.6% to ILS 79.8 million.
why: Max Stock is a leading value retailer in Israel, offering visibility into local household consumption and retail operating margins amid regional economic conditions.

impacts.name: Max Stock Limited
impacts.why: Double-digit revenue and comparable store sales growth alongside margin expansion drive profitability higher.
